'''CEC Island''', best known as the '''CEC Headquarters''', was the headquarters of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].<ref name="TOR" /><ref name="SoF" /> The CEC Island was a vast complex of buildings located in the [[Incorporation Islands]] district of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Description==
Largely used as a public relations tool, the company's real work transpired on the [[Orbital Industrial Zone]] high-above the planet. The sprawling, beach-side campus consisted of several buildings and towers, including the [[Corellian Museum of Space Exploration]].<ref name="SoF" />

==History==
The CEC Island was the site of intense fighting during the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
